corrections: Current main's h >= 0 inequality convention and default analytic mode are retained.
Positive gradient weights scale residuals consistently with projected inequality updates.
Constraint/global weights use Jacobian Frobenius norms, avoiding the vanishing gradient of a satisfied residual norm.
Padding preserves reductions and excludes dummy entries from multiplier statistics.
Public DOFs already include geometry/current normalization; legacy use_scaled_main_params does not apply it twice.
Checkpoint reconstruction restores nested composite autoscales and numerical metadata.
Restart resets and checkpoint iteration helpers repair incomplete source-branch implementations.
SciPy L-BFGS-B is the default and needs no Optax/JAXopt. ALM_model_jaxopt_lbfgsb restores native JAXopt as an optional backend, sharing all ALM updates.
Global as well as per-element tolerances tighten at unit penalty; exact-zero objective norms use a finite zero subgradient.
Legacy numeric EmptyState checkpoints load without Optax; full Python closures retain their own dependency requirements.
